data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Picovoice's offline wake word engine.
data.what_it_does: It provides bindings to the Porcupine wake word engine, enabling offline and private voice-activated applications on Android and iOS. It offers both a high-level manager that handles audio recording automatically and a low-level API for custom audio pipelines.
use_when: You need offline, private wake-word detection in your Flutter app.
You want to use custom or built-in keyword `.ppn` files for voice commands.
avoid_when: You need general-purpose speech-to-text transcription rather than specific wake word detection.
You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS.
strengths: Cross-platform support for Android and iOS.
Provides both high-level audio recording management and low-level processing.
weaknesses: Custom wake words have restrictions on platforms and commercial usage depending on the Picovoice console tier.
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring a Picovoice AccessKey, adding microphone permissions in Info.plist (iOS) and AndroidManifest.xml (Android), and setting iOS deployment strip style if necessary.
